scope: History dictionary loading, Firestore read cost and menu naming

client.storage: IndexedDB; shared catalog content and version only

regressions: Snapshot publication is content addressed, verified and CAS protected; source documents preserved
Legacy 500-item clients and 5001-item / 8 MiB pagination remain supported
Whole snapshot SHA checked after pagination; mixed generations rejected
Reload reuses persistent content; changed version replaces it
Corrupt and cyclic local cache, blocked storage and quota errors recover safely
Denied requests never display local cached content
Identity changes during pending token reads reject stale responses
No student notebook, session or permission result caching
Teacher tab subscriptions are deferred and cleaned up on navigation/account change
